title: Adding Three Numbers
standard_text: 1.5G apply properties of operations to add and subtract two or three numbers
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 worksheets for Texas TEKS 1.5G: add three numbers within 20 with pictures, doubles, make 10, any order and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Add in any order; look for 10 or a double first.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Add two numbers first, then add the third.
  • You can add in any order. The sum stays the same.
  • Look for a double or a 10 first: 4 + 7 + 6 = 10 + 7 = 17.

Examples

Example

4 + 7 + 6

4 + 6 = 10

10 + 7

Answer: 17

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding only two numbersTouch each number as you add it.
Counting a number twiceCross out each number you use.
Thinking a new order changes the sum3 + 5 + 2 = 2 + 3 + 5.

items.q: Use a double first. What is the first step for 2 + 7 + 2?
items.e: There are two 2s, so start with 2 + 2 = 4. There is only one 7, so 7 + 7 does not fit. Then 4 + 7 = 11.

items.q: Use a double first. What is the first step for 6 + 1 + 6?
